items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did Clem play like? What kind of style did Edward Cleve play? [INTERVIEWEE] He was a jazz trumpet player.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. That sounds good. That's nice. I was going to ask you, do you remember how Buddy Bolden played? No. Not clearly, huh? No. But do you remember Clem style? Can you play it again?
Clem play something in style that don't play any day.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. Play on that order, huh? Yeah. And who else do you remember that you could maybe give a little sample of that style? Is there anybody that you copied or anything?
